newsitem.title: USA: Rankin names CFO, senior vice president.
newsitem.headline: Rankin names CFO, senior vice president.

text.p: Rankin Automotive Group Inc said Wednesday it has named Deborah Eddlemon senior vice president of finance and administration.
She will also serve as the company's chief financial officer, the company said.
Rankin said it also appointed Murray Sullivan as senior vice president.
Eddlemon had been a partner in a Louisiana public accounting firm and chief financial officer for a group of 14 private companies, the company said.
Sullivan had been a division vice president for sales and marketing for APS' Installer Service Warehouse, the company said.
